business_summary: Zuiko Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and provides consulting services for disposable hygiene product machines in Japan, China, Asia, Europe, North America, Central and South America, and internationally. Its converting machines are used to produce baby and adult diapers, feminine napkins, and face masks, as well as pet sheets and nursing pads, incontinence pads. The company also offers medical equipment and intermediary medical systems; pet care products; recycling equipment; and equipment, systems, and related software products related to converting machines. In addition, it manufactures and sells spunlace nonwoven fabrics. Zuiko Corporation was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
